description_en: Modifies some information about a dedicated host cluster, including the name, description, and properties of the dedicated host cluster
description_zh: 修改一台专有宿主机组的部分信息，包括专有宿主机组的名称、描述信息、属性等
kebab_example: aliyun ecs modify-dedicated-host-cluster-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dedicated-host-cluster-id dc-bp12wlf6am0vz9v20000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDedicatedHostClusterAttribute

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the dedicated host cluster. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 专有宿主机组所在的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the dedicated host cluster
parameters.name: dedicated_host_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the dedicated host cluster. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter. The name cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: 专有宿主机组的名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符，必须以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、英文句号（.）、下划线（_）或连字符（-）。不能包含`http://`和`https://`
parameters.name: dedicated_host_cluster_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the dedicated host cluster. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. The description cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: 专有宿主机组的描述。长度为2~256个字符。不能以`http://`和`https://`开头
parameters.name: description
